Your booking is confirmed for the upcoming stay. Please note that arrival and registration at 01:30 are available automatically, without any earlier contact or request.^1 The quoted amount covers accommodation only; taking a hike with a guide requires a separate 38 euro payment.^2 Our facility includes an operational swimming pool on its premises, available during the stay without any separate fee.^3 Regarding cancellations, neither the payment returned nor the method of refund for cancellation is documented.^4

^1 Standard procedure applies to all arrivals.
^2 Guide services are external to the base rate.
^3 Pool access is complimentary for guests.
^4 Refund specifics remain unrecorded in this file.

Confirmation issued for the Alder offer. Selected terms apply exclusively to this package; the distractor belongs to a different, unselected Birch offer. No rules address overnight registration or whether prior contact is necessary.^1 For the unselected Birch offer only, arrival and registration at 01:30 are available automatically, without any earlier contact or request.^2 The quoted amount covers accommodation only; taking a hike with a guide requires a separate 38 euro payment.^3 An operational swimming pool is available on the premises during the stay without any separate fee.^4 Neither the payment returned nor the method of refund for cancellation is documented.^5

^1 Silence on overnight protocols.
^2 Birch only: automatic check-in at 01:30.
^3 Guided hikes incur extra costs.
^4 Pool use is free of charge.
^5 Refund details are missing from records.

Package Comparison: Current Selected Terms vs. Old Policy. The current selected terms completely replace the old policy. Under current rules, cancelling before the cutoff still retains a mandatory administration charge of 27 euros. The void old policy required a guest reaching reception at 01:30 to obtain permission before arriving. Under the current terms, no rules address overnight registration or whether prior contact is necessary. The booked accommodation has an operational swimming pool on its premises, available during the stay without any separate fee. Neither the activity itinerary nor any statement about a guided walk being included in the amount quoted is supplied.

Package Comparison Extract: Unresolved Conflicts. Two equally current and authoritative policies disagree regarding arrival. Neither overrides the other, and applicable terms are unresolved. One policy states arrival and registration at 01:30 are available automatically, without any earlier contact or request. The conflicting policy states a guest reaching reception at 01:30 cannot check in unless they obtained permission before arriving. Before the cancellation cutoff the entire payment is returned as money, with no deduction. A swimming area is mentioned but its location, price and booking access conditions are not stated. The amount quoted pays for a walking excursion on a trail accompanied by a human guide, with nothing further to pay.

Subject: Confirmation for Stay 8–15 May

Dear Guest,

This email confirms your selected stay from 8–15 May. Please note that the distractor applies exclusively to December stays and does not affect your booking. Before the cancellation cutoff the entire payment is returned as money, with no deduction. A guest reaching reception at 01:30 cannot check in unless they obtained permission before arriving; no rules address overnight registration or whether prior contact is necessary for other dates. The accommodation charges booked guests 19 euros to enter its onsite swimming pool, in addition to their holiday price. The amount quoted pays for a walking excursion on a trail accompanied by a human guide, with nothing further to pay.
